mapper.sql: SELECT u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.data_scope, u.status, u.del_flag, u.create_time, u.update_time, d.dept_name, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(r.role_name ORDER BY r.role_id SEPARATOR '、') FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.user_id ) AS role_names FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id
